prerequisite: Already published previous photo-time and station-weight results are known. This is a new independent satellite SOURCE ACCESS/QA test, not an animal outcome or an NDVI–animal association.
original_source: Microsoft Planetary Computer openly indexed NASA MOD13Q1 v061 Terra vegetation indices, no signed-in account required; STAC requires signed Azure SAS file URL
product: MOD13Q1 Terra ONLY; do not accidentally pool MYD13Q1 Aqua

spatial_frame.site_type: public coarse representative climate-region point chosen in earlier ERA5 v0 before NDVI read. NOT exact original Serengeti camera locations
spatial_frame.roi: 3 x 3 MODIS sinusoidal raster pixels centered on this representative point, approximately 0.75-km square

ndvi_raster.marginal_pixel_1: must exclude from primary, can count but cannot use in primary median
ndvi_raster.good_only_median: median of good-quality 3x3 scaled NDVI; if <6 good pixels report QA_HOLD, never interpolate

output.report: at most date, source STAC item id, source raster metadata, number of good/marginal/cloud pixel samples, median good NDVI if enough pixels; never exact protected camera coordinates, no source animal outcomes

decision_to_expand: Expand to ~80 scene 2010-2013 historical vegetation only after successful actual COG+QA read and point/sampling repro. Never select item dates after animal response.
known_historical_problem: ORNL MODIS original REST API metadata succeeded but Serengeti coordinates subset GET timed out, so no NDVI data previously used.
